title.text: Dubai: Skydive Experience at The Palm with Photos & Video

pills.label: 13,000 ft jump
pills.pop_html: The jump: A 20-minute climb by plane, exit at 13,000 ft (4,000 m), nearly 60 seconds of freefall at about 120 mph, parachute open at around 6,000 ft, then a 4–5 minute canopy ride down over the dunes and Palm Jumeirah.

pills.label: Photos + video
pills.pop_html: Included: A camera flyer jumps alongside you and films the whole dive, plus a short interview after landing. You get digital photos and a professionally edited video, so there is no add-on to buy at the desk.

pills.label: 18+, weight limits
pills.pop_html: Who can jump: 18 or older on the day. Women up to 90 kg (above 85 kg, BMI max 27.5), men up to 100 kg (above 95 kg, BMI max 30), weighed in clothes and shoes. The general terms also flag guests over 91 kg, so confirm with the operator first if you are near the limit. Over 70, or with conditions like epilepsy, diabetes, high blood pressure or heart disease, you need a doctor's certificate.

pills.label: 3–4 hours total
pills.pop_html: Your day: Briefing and harness fitting start about an hour before boarding. Friends and family can watch the landing from below, and there is an on-site café for light food and drinks.

best_for.pick_html: for anyone who wants the biggest thrill on this page, because a 13,000 ft freefall over the Palm with a filmed video is the one experience here no other activity can imitate
best_for.skip_html: if you are under 18, over the weight or BMI limit, or your dates might change, because the booking is non-refundable

items.a: Tandem skydive, photos, professionally edited video, The Palm drop zone.
Non-refundable.
Skydive Dubai, Al Seyahi St, Dubai Marina.
18+, women max 90 kg, men max 100 kg (BMI rules near the top), doctor's certificate if over 70 or with listed conditions.
Passport or ID, sports shoes, comfortable sportswear. No sandals, heels, boots, sleeveless shirts or swimwear.

title.text: Parasailing Burj Al Arab w free Pictures, Videos & Ice Cream

pills.label: 50 m, 10 min
pills.pop_html: The flight: About 10 minutes on the line at 50 m, flown in front of the Burj Al Arab when the wind allows (otherwise near the beach). The boat cruises about 5 minutes out, and the whole session lasts about an hour with up to 4 groups on board.

pills.label: Solo or duo
pills.pop_html: Who flies: Fly alone or as a pair. Solo flights need at least 45 kg, maximum is 150 kg for solo and duo. Children from 6 can fly on duo flights, and under-18s need a guardian to sign the waiver.

pills.label: Dry take-off
pills.pop_html: The boat: Take-off and landing are from a deck on a specially built boat, so there is no water start. Expect some splashing, and you may get wet on landing depending on the wind.

pills.label: Lockers, shower
pills.pop_html: At the marina: Drinking water, lockers, a changing room with open shower, Wi-Fi and charging, plus 20% off food and drinks at Lumiere Cafe. The GoPro photo and video package is optional and chosen at check-in.

best_for.pick_html: for first-timers and families who want real height with the Burj Al Arab in the frame, because €51 for a 10-minute flight is the best thrill-per-euro on this page
best_for.skip_html: if you want the photos guaranteed in the price, because the GoPro package is an optional extra at check-in

items.a: Parasailing ride, crew, drinking water, locker, changing room with open shower, Wi-Fi and charging, 20% off at Lumiere Cafe.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Nemo WaterSports, Fishing Harbour, Jumeirah St, Umm Suqeim 2.
6+ (duo flights for children), solo minimum 45 kg, maximum 150 kg, not for pregnant women.
GoPro photo and video package, chosen at check-in.

title.text: Dubai: Jet Car Tour of Burj Al Arab with Photos and Videos

pills.label: You drive, 30 min
pills.pop_html: The ride: A 30-minute guided drive in a red 2-seater jet car: out of the marina to the Burj Al Arab, past Jumeirah Beach Hotel, along the Palm and past Sheikh Island, going as fast as you like with the instructor alongside.

pills.label: ≈ €62 each for 2
pills.pop_html: Real cost: The €124 price is per car for up to 2 people, so a couple pays about €62 each, around €4 per minute for the car.

pills.label: Photos + videos
pills.pop_html: Included: The instructor shoots photos and videos of you during the ride, with an optional photo stop facing the Burj Khalifa skyline.

pills.label: Ice cream, showers
pills.pop_html: Also included: Drinking water, ice cream, lockers, a changing room with open shower, Wi-Fi and charging, and a sea-view seating area. Arrive 15 minutes early for registration and the safety briefing.

best_for.pick_html: for couples who want to share one thrill and drive it themselves, because €124 covers two people, 30 minutes and the instructor's photos and videos
best_for.skip_html: if you are travelling solo, because you pay the full per-car price, or if you want height rather than speed

items.a: 2-seater jet car ride, instructor, photos and videos, drinking water, ice cream, locker, changing room with open shower, Wi-Fi and charging, sea-view seating.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Yoush Water Sports Jetski Dubai, P&O Marina Port, Fishing Harbour, Jumeirah St, Umm Suqeim 2.
Not for children under 5, pregnant women or people with high blood pressure.
Passport or ID, swimwear, towel. No luggage or large bags.

title.text: Dubai: Dinner in the Sky Experience

pills.label: 50 m above ground
pills.pop_html: The setting: A shared table lifted 50 m by a crane, rotating slightly while you eat, with a safety supervisor at the table. Views take in Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah and the Burj Al Arab.

pills.label: 3 courses, live
pills.pop_html: On the menu: Chefs cook in front of you. Burrata starter, then Angus beef short rib, sous-vide chicken breast, vegetarian tortellini or vegan penne, and a chocolate sphere with ice cream. Tell the operator your choice at least 24 hours ahead.

pills.label: No alcohol
pills.pop_html: Drinks: Fresh juice, soft drinks, coffee and tea are included. Alcoholic drinks are not served.

pills.label: 8+, 120 cm
pills.pop_html: Who can join: Minimum age 8, at least 1.2 m tall, maximum 150 kg. Bring your own camera and dress for the weather.

best_for.pick_html: for couples or groups where not everyone wants to jump, because €198 buys 90 minutes 50 m up with a 3-course meal cooked live and the Palm in view
best_for.skip_html: if you want a real adrenaline rush or a drink with dinner, because it is a seated meal and no alcohol is served

items.a: 3-course menu, fresh juice and soft drinks, coffee and tea.
Alcoholic drinks.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Al Seyahi St, Dubai Marina (Skydive Dubai address).
8+, at least 1.2 m tall, maximum 150 kg.

pills.label: ≈ 500 ft up
pills.pop_html: The flight: Up to about 500 ft above the water for 10–15 minutes, depending on wind and sea. Views over Palm Jumeirah, Atlantis, Dubai Marina, JBR and the Burj Al Arab in the distance.

pills.label: Up to 3 together
pills.pop_html: Who flies: The boat can lift 2 or 3 people at once. Ages 6 to 80, children with an adult, combined weight between 55 kg and 180 kg.

pills.label: Photos on your phone
pills.pop_html: Media: A crew member can shoot photos and videos with your own phone during the flight.

pills.label: Max 10 guests
pills.pop_html: Group size: Small group of up to 10 on a new boat with a music system. The outing includes a safety briefing and returns to Dubai Harbour Yacht Club.

best_for.pick_html: for families or friends who want to fly two or three at a time and go higher, because this boat takes up to 3 people to about 500 ft over the Palm
best_for.skip_html: if the Burj Al Arab backdrop matters most or you want the lowest price, because #2 flies right in front of it for €35 less

items.a: Boat ride, onboard music, parasailing, instructors, safety briefing.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Dubai Harbour Yacht Club, Dubai Marina.
Ages 6 to 80, children with an adult, combined weight 55–180 kg, not for pregnant women.
Passport or ID, swimwear, towel, breathable clothing.

title.text: Dubai: Jet Car to Burj Al Arab or Atlantis

pills.label: 20, 30 or 60 min
pills.pop_html: Ride lengths: Three ride lengths: 20, 30 and 60 minutes. The longer rides can reach Atlantis on Palm Jumeirah, with photo stops at the Burj Al Arab and sailing past Umm Suqeim.

pills.label: 1,800 cc supercharged
pills.pop_html: The car: Three water cars in green, red and white, each with a 1,800 cc supercharged engine, four Bluetooth speakers, a spoiler and mirrors. A licensed guide rides with you.

pills.label: Breakfast + drink
pills.pop_html: Included: Light breakfast from 8 AM to 11 AM and a soft drink from 8 AM to 2 PM, plus unlimited bottled water, life jacket, Wi-Fi, beach access, free lockers, shower and changing room.

pills.label: Video sold on site
pills.pop_html: Media: A professional photographer offers edited pictures and videos set to music, available only on site, so budget extra if you want them.

best_for.pick_html: for couples on a budget or anyone who wants a longer 60-minute drive out to Atlantis, because the 20-minute ride starts at €100 per car for two
best_for.skip_html: if you want photos and videos included, because #3 bundles them and this operator sells them on site

items.a: Guide, life jacket, unlimited bottled water, Wi-Fi, beach access, free lockers, shower, changing room, light breakfast (8–11 AM), soft drink (8 AM–2 PM).
Professional photos and videos (sold on site), towel, swimsuit, parking (AED 3 per hour).
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
553X+36, Umm Suqeim, Dubai.
Not for children under 5 or pregnant women.
